hypothesis: Outcome-triggered half weight improves the next fixed-update student compared with fixed high and independent acquisition.
platform_scope: Local native MuJoCo3.6 on macOSarm64; all new arms share this platform. Historical trigger/checkpoint were produced on Linuxx86; no cross-host bitwise inference/physics or causal-effect comparison is claimed.
stopping_rule: Acquire all six complete attempts. Any failed required teacher task/cost guard stops child fitting while retaining incoming-parent primary and acquisition-start evaluations. Otherwise exactly three fixed 2k fits, paired primary and acquisition-start diagnostics, confirmation only on primary benefit. No data substitution, rho retry, representation change or fit extension. Round2 requires its own frozen confirmed-parent inputs.
claim_scope: One prospective feedback-selected weight reduction at a fixed updated learner. Not a test against fixed-half/open-loop schedules and not convergence.
